items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Willie Bryant told him, said, 'Man, why don't you get that band out there at Dykes?' ... Willie Bryant, who was a helluva MC...

ctx.x: Is he the one from New York?

Yeah. So Willie Bryant told him, said, 'Man, why don't you get that band out there at Dykes? They're cookin', man. They're a good band. They can play these shows.' So Carwell hired us... You know, he's full of shit anyway; we had to give him hell, you know. There was a lot of things he was talking about he wanted us to do. He didn't want to pay no money, not what you were supposed to be getting. So we put in a notice a couple of times, and we were prepared to leave, and he came up with the money. The War was on…
